segments.an6.42:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena icchānaṅgalaṃ nāma kosalānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tadavasari.
segments.an6.42:1.3: Tatra sudaṃ bhagavā icchānaṅgale viharati icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe.
segments.an6.42:1.5: “samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito icchānaṅgalaṃ anuppatto icchānaṅgale viharati icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe.
segments.an6.42:1.6: Taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato –
segments.an6.42:1.7: ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno … pe … buddho bhagavā’ti.
segments.an6.42:1.8: So imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ … pe … arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī”ti.
segments.an6.42:1.9: Atha kho icchānaṅgalakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā tassā rattiyā accayena pahūtaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ ādāya yena icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bahidvārakoṭṭhake aṭṭhaṃsu uccāsaddā mahāsaddā.
segments.an6.42:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā nāgito bhagavato upaṭṭhāko hoti.
segments.an6.42:2.2: Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ nāgitaṃ āmantesi –
segments.an6.42:2.3: “ke pana te, nāgita, uccāsaddā mahāsaddā kevaṭṭā maññe macchavilope”ti?
segments.an6.42:2.4: “Ete, bhante, icchānaṅgalakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā pahūtaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ ādāya bahidvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitā bhagavantaṃyeva uddissa bhikkhusaṅghañcā”ti.
segments.an6.42:2.5: “Māhaṃ, nāgita, yasena samāgamaṃ, mā ca mayā yaso.
segments.an6.42:2.6: Yo kho, nāgita, nayimassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assa akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, so taṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ lābhasakkārasilokasukhaṃ sādiyeyyā”ti.
segments.an6.42:3.3: Yena yeneva dāni, bhante, bhagavā gamissati, tanninnāva bhavissanti brāhmaṇagahapatikā negamā ceva jānapadā ca.
segments.an6.42:3.4: Seyyathāpi, bhante, thullaphusitake deve vassante yathāninnaṃ udakāni pavattanti;
segments.an6.42:3.5: evamevaṃ kho, bhante, yena yeneva dāni bhagavā gamissati, tanninnāva bhavissanti brāhmaṇagahapatikā negamā ceva jānapadā ca.
segments.an6.42:4.1: “Māhaṃ, nāgita, yasena samāgamaṃ, mā ca mayā yaso.
segments.an6.42:4.2: Yo kho, nāgita, nayimassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assa akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, so taṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ lābhasakkārasilokasukhaṃ sādiyeyya.
segments.an6.42:5.1: “Idhāhaṃ, nāgita, bhikkhuṃ passāmi gāmantavihāriṃ samāhitaṃ nisinnaṃ.
segments.an6.42:5.3: ‘idānimaṃ āyasmantaṃ [ārāmiko vā ghaṭṭessati samaṇuddeso vā, taṃ tamhā (ka. sī. pī.) ārāmiko vā ghaṭṭessati samaṇuddeso vā, so taṃ tamhā (ka. sī.) a. ni.8.86 passitabbaṃ] ārāmiko vā upaṭṭhahissati samaṇuddeso vā taṃ tamhā [ārāmiko vā ghaṭṭessati samaṇuddeso vā, taṃ tamhā (ka. sī. pī.) ārāmiko vā ghaṭṭessati samaṇuddeso vā, so taṃ tamhā (ka. sī.) a. ni.8.86 passitabbaṃ] samādhimhā cāvessatī’ti.
segments.an6.42:5.4: Tenāhaṃ, nāgita, tassa bhikkhuno na attamano homi gāmantavihārena.
segments.an6.42:6.1: Idha panāhaṃ, nāgita, bhikkhuṃ passāmi āraññikaṃ araññe pacalāyamānaṃ nisinnaṃ.
segments.an6.42:6.3: ‘idāni ayamāyasmā imaṃ niddākilamathaṃ paṭivinodetvā araññasaññaṃyeva manasi karissati ekattan’ti.
segments.an6.42:6.4: Tenāhaṃ, nāgita, tassa bhikkhuno attamano homi araññavihārena.
segments.an6.42:7.1: “Idha panāhaṃ, nāgita, bhikkhuṃ passāmi āraññikaṃ araññe asamāhitaṃ nisinnaṃ.
segments.an6.42:7.3: ‘idāni ayamāyasmā asamāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ samādahissati, samāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ anurakkhissatī’ti.
segments.an6.42:7.4: Tenāhaṃ, nāgita, tassa bhikkhuno attamano homi araññavihārena.
segments.an6.42:8.1: “Idha panāhaṃ, nāgita, bhikkhuṃ passāmi āraññikaṃ araññe samāhitaṃ nisinnaṃ.
segments.an6.42:8.3: ‘idāni ayamāyasmā avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimocessati, vimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ anurakkhissatī’ti.
segments.an6.42:8.4: Tenāhaṃ, nāgita, tassa bhikkhuno attamano homi araññavihārena.
segments.an6.42:9.1: “Idha panāhaṃ, nāgita, bhikkhuṃ passāmi gāmantavihāriṃ lābhiṃ cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānappaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ.
segments.an6.42:9.2: So taṃ lābhasakkārasilokaṃ nikāmayamāno riñcati paṭisallānaṃ riñcati araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni;
segments.an6.42:9.4: Tenāhaṃ, nāgita, tassa bhikkhuno na attamano homi gāmantavihārena.
segments.an6.42:10.1: “Idha panāhaṃ, nāgita, bhikkhuṃ passāmi āraññikaṃ lābhiṃ cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānappaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ.
segments.an6.42:10.2: So taṃ lābhasakkārasilokaṃ paṭipaṇāmetvā na riñcati paṭisallānaṃ na riñcati araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni.
segments.an6.42:10.3: Tenāhaṃ, nāgita, tassa bhikkhuno attamano homi araññavihārena.
segments.an6.42:11.1: Yasmāhaṃ, nāgita, samaye addhānamaggappaṭipanno na kañci [na kiñci (sī. pī. ka.)] passāmi purato vā pacchato vā, phāsu me, nāgita, tasmiṃ samaye hoti antamaso uccārapassāvakammāyā”ti.

lines: Samāhitaṃ nisinnanti tasmiṃ gāmantasenāsane samādhiṃ appetvā nisinnaṃ.
Ekattanti ekasabhāvaṃ, ekaggatābhūtaṃ araññasaññaṃyeva citte karissatīti attho.
Avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimocessatīti aññasmiṃ kāle avimuttaṃ cittaṃ idāni pañcahi vimuttīhi vimocayissati.
Iminā ettakena ṭhānena satthārā araññasenāsanassa vaṇṇo kathito.
Suttassa pana paṭhamakoṭṭhāse yaṃ vattabbaṃ, taṃ heṭṭhā vuttamevāti.
Dvādasame māhaṃ nāgita yasena samāgamanti mā ahaṃ yasena samāgamanaṃ patthemi.
Mā ca mayā yasoti yaso ca mayā mā samāgacchatūti attho.
